How does pricing work?

Your basket budget includes gifts, wrapping, and my shopping fee of 25% ($15 minimum). On a $75 budget, $56.25 goes toward gifts and packaging. The first five paying customers get $5 off the fee. I’ll confirm any tax or delivery charge before you decide.
